DLG-SC-LOC-025-19-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-025-19-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: ふなずしは、召し上がったことがありますか。

DLG-SC-LOC-025-19-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-025-19-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 初めてです。友人は大きい皿を勧めますが、私は味が分からないので、少ない量で試したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-025-19-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 初料理で友人の大皿勧奨より本人少量試食を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-025-19-001-SHARED-02.translation: This is my first time. My friend recommends a large plate, but I do not know the taste, so I would like to try a small amount.
DLG-SC-LOC-025-19-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you prefer a small tasting portion for an unfamiliar dish rather than the large plate your friend recommends. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-025-19-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-025-19-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: こちらの小皿をお選びいただけます。お友達と同じ量になさらなくても結構です。
DLG-SC-LOC-025-19-001-SHARED-03.translation: You can choose this small plate. You do not have to have the same amount as your friend.

DLG-SC-LOC-025-19-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-025-19-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 小皿にします。友人が好きだから自分も同じだけ食べられるとは限らないので、自分の分として一つお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-025-19-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 友人の好物でも本人可食量を同一にせず小皿一つを選ぶ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-025-19-001-SHARED-04.translation: I will have the small plate. Just because my friend likes it does not mean I can eat as much, so please give me one for my own portion.
DLG-SC-LOC-025-19-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Choose one small plate without assuming you can eat as much as your friend just because it is their favorite. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-025-19-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-025-19-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 飲み物も、お決めになりましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-025-19-001-SHARED-05.translation: Have you also decided on a drink?

DLG-SC-LOC-025-19-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-025-19-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: お茶をお願いします。料理を苦手に感じても、友人の前で無理に追加を頼む約束はしていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-025-19-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: お茶を注文し友人への見栄で追加を約束していないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-025-19-001-SHARED-06.translation: Tea, please. I have not promised to force myself to order more in front of my friend even if I find the dish difficult to eat.
DLG-SC-LOC-025-19-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Order tea and say you have not promised to order more to keep up appearances with your friend. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-025-19-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-025-19-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 小皿とお茶をお持ちしました。ご自身のペースでお召し上がりください。
DLG-SC-LOC-025-19-001-SHARED-07.translation: Here are your small plate and tea. Please eat at your own pace.

DLG-SC-LOC-025-19-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-025-19-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 少し食べました。私には味が強く感じますが、作り方が悪いと決める意味ではありません。今日は追加せず、この量で終えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-025-19-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 味の強さを主観として述べ調理不良の断定でなく追加なしを選ぶ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-025-19-001-SHARED-08.translation: I have tried a little. The flavor feels strong to me, but I do not mean that I have decided it was badly prepared. I will not order more today and will finish with this amount.
DLG-SC-LOC-025-19-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Describe the strong flavor as your own impression rather than a judgment of poor preparation, and choose not to order more. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-025-19-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-025-19-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 承知しました。ほかにご希望はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-025-19-001-SHARED-09.translation: Understood. Would you like anything else?

DLG-SC-LOC-025-19-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-025-19-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: ありません。初めて試せてよかったです。友人にも、好き嫌いを競うためでなく、自分の量で味を確かめたと話します。
DLG-SC-LOC-025-19-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 試食への礼を述べ好みを競わず自分の量で確認したと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-025-19-001-SHARED-10.translation: No. I am glad I could try it for the first time. I will also tell my friend I checked the taste with my own portion, rather than competing over likes and dislikes.
DLG-SC-LOC-025-19-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Express appreciation for trying it and explain that you checked the taste with your own portion rather than competing over preferences. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-025-19-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-025-19-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ご来店ありがとうございます。それでは、ごゆっくりお過ごしください。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-025-19-001-SHARED-11.translation: Thank you for visiting. Please take your time. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-025-20-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-025-20-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 入口に来た見学の方とは、何のお話をしましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-025-20-001-SHARED-01.translation: What did you discuss with the visitor who came to the entrance?

DLG-SC-LOC-025-20-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-025-20-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 工事がいつ終わるか聞かれました。私は資材の記録補助なので、現場全体の完成日を約束せず、責任者へつなぐと答えました。
DLG-SC-LOC-025-20-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 記録補助の本人は完成日を約束せず責任者へつなぐと回答したと報告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-025-20-001-SHARED-02.translation: They asked when construction would finish. I assist with materials records, so I said I would connect them with the person in charge without promising a completion date for the whole site.
DLG-SC-LOC-025-20-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Report that as a recordkeeping assistant you replied that you would refer the visitor to the person in charge without promising a completion date. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-025-20-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-025-20-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: その対応で結構です。工程の資料を、その方へ見せたりしましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-025-20-001-SHARED-03.translation: That response is fine. Did you show them any schedule documents?

DLG-SC-LOC-025-20-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-025-20-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 見せていません。自分が今日使う記録用紙だけ持っていて、公開してよい工程表は分かりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-025-20-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 工程資料未提示で公開可資料を知らないと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-025-20-001-SHARED-04.translation: No. I only have the record sheet I am using today, and I do not know which schedule can be made public.
DLG-SC-LOC-025-20-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you showed no schedule documents and do not know which documents can be made public. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-025-20-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-025-20-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 工事の説明は広報担当へつなぎます。見学の方は、今どちらにいらっしゃいますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-025-20-001-SHARED-05.translation: We will connect them with the public-relations staff for an explanation of the construction. Where is the visitor now?

DLG-SC-LOC-025-20-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-025-20-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 受付の外で待っています。私の後を付いて作業場所へ入ってよいとは伝えていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-025-20-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 見学者の受付外待機と作業場所への同行許可未付与を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-025-20-001-SHARED-06.translation: They are waiting outside reception. I have not told them they can follow me into the work area.
DLG-SC-LOC-025-20-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say the visitor is waiting outside reception and you have not permitted them to accompany you into the work area. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-025-20-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-025-20-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 受付で担当者が対応します。あなたは今日の記録の仕事へ戻ってください。
DLG-SC-LOC-025-20-001-SHARED-07.translation: The staff will assist them at reception. Please return to today's recordkeeping work.

DLG-SC-LOC-025-20-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-025-20-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 戻ります。質問に答えられなかったからと、自分で完成日を調べて勝手に後から連絡することはしません。
DLG-SC-LOC-025-20-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 本人記録へ戻り完成日を自己調査して独断連絡しないと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-025-20-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will. I will not investigate the completion date myself and contact them later on my own just because I could not answer the question.
DLG-SC-LOC-025-20-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will return to your records and will not investigate the completion date and contact the visitor independently. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-025-20-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-025-20-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 分からないことを推測で埋めなかった点も、引継ぎで伝えておきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-025-20-001-SHARED-09.translation: I will also mention in the handover that you did not fill in unknown details with guesses.

DLG-SC-LOC-025-20-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-025-20-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: お願いします。見学者には、私から完成日のお返事をするという約束をしていないことも共有してください。記録作業へ戻ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-025-20-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 本人から日付回答を約束していない点も引継ぎを頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-025-20-001-SHARED-10.translation: Please do. Please also share that I have not promised to reply with a completion date myself. I will return to recordkeeping.
DLG-SC-LOC-025-20-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Ask for the handover to include that you have not promised to reply with the date yourself. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-025-20-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-025-20-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。それでは、受付の担当へ引き継ぎます。今日の記録もよろしくお願いします。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-025-20-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. I will hand this over to reception staff. Thank you for your recordkeeping today too. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-025-21-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-025-21-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お店でのカード決済について、ご相談ですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-025-21-001-SHARED-01.translation: You would like to discuss card payments at your shop, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-025-21-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-025-21-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 一日だけ屋外で店を出します。お客様のカードを受け付けたいのですが、会場には自分の通信設備がないので、申込みの前に必要な準備を聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-025-21-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 屋外一日店舗のカード受付希望と会場通信未整備を申込み前に相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-025-21-001-SHARED-02.translation: I am setting up an outdoor shop for just one day. I would like to accept customers' cards, but I do not have my own communications equipment at the venue, so I want to ask about preparations before applying.
DLG-SC-LOC-025-21-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Before applying, discuss wanting to accept cards at a one-day outdoor shop with communications at the venue not arranged. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-025-21-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-025-21-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 会場の通信や電源も含めて、決済の担当が条件を確認します。常設のお店で使うご予定ではないのですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-025-21-001-SHARED-03.translation: The payments staff will check the conditions, including communications and power at the venue. You are not planning to use it in a permanent shop, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-025-21-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-025-21-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 常設ではありません。自宅で機械が動けば会場でも同じだと思わず、外で一日使う事情を先に伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-025-21-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 常設店でなく自宅動作を会場動作へ保証として流用しないと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-025-21-001-SHARED-04.translation: It is not permanent. I will first explain that I am using it outdoors for one day, without assuming it will work the same at the venue just because the device works at home.
DLG-SC-LOC-025-21-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain it is not a permanent shop and you will not treat operation at home as a guarantee of operation at the venue. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-025-21-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-025-21-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: ご利用を希望する日と、設備について分かっていることを整理してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-025-21-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please organize the date you want to use it and what you know about the equipment.

DLG-SC-LOC-025-21-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-025-21-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 来月の土曜日です。主催者へ電源の利用を聞いていますが、まだ返事がありません。使えると書いて申し込むことはしません。
DLG-SC-LOC-025-21-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 来月土曜利用と主催者への電源可否照会未回答を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-025-21-001-SHARED-06.translation: It is a Saturday next month. I have asked the organizer about using power, but have not received a reply yet. I will not apply stating that power is available.
DLG-SC-LOC-025-21-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you want to use it on a Saturday next month and have not yet received the organizer's reply about power. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-025-21-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-025-21-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 担当へそのままお伝えいただけます。端末の用意や料金は、条件を確認してからのご案内です。
DLG-SC-LOC-025-21-001-SHARED-07.translation: You can tell the staff exactly that. We will explain terminal arrangements and charges after checking the conditions.

DLG-SC-LOC-025-21-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-025-21-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 一日の使用でも長い契約が必要なのか、費用がどの期間にかかるかを聞きたいです。今ここで機械だけ受け取れば済むとは考えません。
DLG-SC-LOC-025-21-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 端末取得だけでなく一日利用の契約期間と費用対象期間を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-025-21-001-SHARED-08.translation: I would like to ask whether even one day's use requires a long contract and what period the costs apply to. I do not think just collecting a device here now is enough.
DLG-SC-LOC-025-21-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask about the contract period and the period charged for one day's use, rather than only obtaining a terminal. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-025-21-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-025-21-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 当日の運用が難しい場合にどうするかも、ご自身でお考えください。
DLG-SC-LOC-025-21-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please also consider for yourself what to do if operating it on the day is difficult.

DLG-SC-LOC-025-21-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-025-21-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 条件が合わなければ、その日は使えるとお客様へ先に宣伝しません。主催者の返事と決済担当の案内を聞いてから、受け付ける支払い方を決めます。
DLG-SC-LOC-025-21-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 未確認段階で受付可能と宣伝せず会場返答と決済条件を聞いて支払方法を決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-025-21-001-SHARED-10.translation: If the conditions are unsuitable, I will not advertise to customers in advance that it can be used that day. I will decide which payment methods to accept after hearing the organizer's reply and the payment staff's guidance.
DLG-SC-LOC-025-21-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will not advertise acceptance before checking, and will decide payment methods after hearing the venue's reply and payment conditions. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-025-21-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-025-21-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: そのご希望で担当へおつなぎします。それでは、ご相談の席でお待ちください。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-025-21-001-SHARED-11.translation: I will refer you to the staff with that request. Please wait in the consultation area. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-026-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-026-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 窓口の列で、お困りでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-026-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you having difficulty in the queue for the counter?

DLG-SC-LOC-026-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-026-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 重い荷物を持っていて、長く立つのがつらくなりました。自分の番を保って座って待てる方法があれば教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-026-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 荷物が重く長時間立位がつらいため受付順を保つ座位待機を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-026-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: I have heavy luggage and standing for a long time has become difficult. If there is a way to sit while keeping my turn, please tell me.
DLG-SC-LOC-026-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask about waiting seated while keeping your turn because heavy luggage makes standing for a long time difficult. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-026-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-026-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: この窓口では番号札でお呼びします。受付済みの札をお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-026-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: This counter calls people by numbered tickets. Do you have a ticket issued at reception?

DLG-SC-LOC-026-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-026-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 十二番を持っています。列に戻る場所を人へ覚えてもらう必要があると思い、ずっと立っていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-026-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 本人十二番札を示し列の物理位置を保つ必要があると思ったと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-026-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: I have number twelve. I thought I needed someone to remember where I should return in the line, so I kept standing.
DLG-SC-LOC-026-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Show your number-twelve ticket and explain that you thought you had to preserve your physical place in line. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-026-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-026-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 番号札をお持ちのまま、こちらの椅子へどうぞ。順番になりましたら番号でお呼びします。
DLG-SC-LOC-026-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: Keep your numbered ticket and take this seat. We will call your number when it is your turn.

DLG-SC-LOC-026-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-026-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 椅子へ移ります。荷物も手元へ置けるので、窓口へ呼ばれたら一緒に持って行けます。
DLG-SC-LOC-026-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 指定椅子へ本人荷物と移り呼出時一緒に持って行けると話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-026-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will move to the chair. I can keep my luggage beside me too, so I can take it with me when called to the counter.
DLG-SC-LOC-026-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you will move to the designated chair with your luggage and can take it along when called. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-026-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-026-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: この席から、呼出しの表示も見られます。
DLG-SC-LOC-026-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: You can see the call display from this seat too.

DLG-SC-LOC-026-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-026-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 十二が出る表示を見ながら待ちます。前の人を探して追いかけるより、番号で自分の番を確かめられますね。
DLG-SC-LOC-026-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 本人番号表示を見て前客ではなく番号で順を確認すると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-026-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will wait while watching for twelve on the display. I can check my turn by number rather than looking for the person ahead and following them.
DLG-SC-LOC-026-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will watch your number on the display and check your turn by number rather than the person ahead. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-026-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-026-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 十二番の方、こちらの窓口へどうぞ。
DLG-SC-LOC-026-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: Number twelve, please come to this counter.

DLG-SC-LOC-026-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-026-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 十二番の札と荷物を持ちました。座って待てたので、落ち着いて用件を説明できます。ご案内ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-026-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 十二番呼出を受け札荷物を持ち休めたため用件を落ち着いて説明できると礼を言う。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-026-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: I have my number-twelve ticket and luggage. Since I could sit while waiting, I can explain my business calmly. Thank you for guiding me.
DLG-SC-LOC-026-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: When number twelve is called, take your ticket and luggage and thank them because resting lets you explain your business calmly. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-026-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-026-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: どういたしまして。それでは、窓口へお進みください。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-026-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: You are welcome. Please proceed to the counter. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-026-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-026-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こちらのお部屋は、靴を脱いでご覧いただきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-026-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Please remove your shoes before viewing this room.

DLG-SC-LOC-026-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-026-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: ひも付きのブーツなので、少し時間がかかります。後ろの方を待たせず、座って準備できる場所はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-026-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: ひも付きブーツの着脱時間を伝え列を妨げず座る準備場所を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-026-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: My boots have laces, so it takes a little time. Is there somewhere to sit and get ready without keeping people behind me waiting?
DLG-SC-LOC-026-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that laced boots take time to remove and put on, and ask for somewhere to prepare seated without blocking the line. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-026-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-026-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: こちらの椅子をお使いください。お連れの方も一緒に見学されますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-026-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please use this chair. Will your companion be visiting with you too?

DLG-SC-LOC-026-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-026-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい。連れは靴をすぐ脱げたので、私を待たず入口へ進みかけています。一緒に入ると伝えてきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-026-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 先へ進む連れへ一緒に入る希望を伝えると話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-026-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes. My companion removed their shoes quickly and is starting to move towards the entrance without waiting for me. I will tell them I want to enter together.
DLG-SC-LOC-026-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you will tell your companion who is moving ahead that you want to enter together. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-026-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-026-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: お二人そろってから、入口の係へお声がけください。
DLG-SC-LOC-026-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: Once both of you are ready, please speak to the staff at the entrance.

DLG-SC-LOC-026-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-026-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 連れに伝えました。ここで座ってひもをほどきます。見学を急いでブーツを傷めるより、準備の時間を取りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-026-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 同行者連絡後ひもをほどき準備時間を確保したいと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-026-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: I have told my companion. I will sit here and untie the laces. I want to allow time to get ready rather than damage my boots by rushing to visit.
DLG-SC-LOC-026-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: After contacting your companion, explain that you will untie the laces and allow time to get ready. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-026-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-026-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 靴を入れる袋はこちらです。準備できましたらお知らせください。
DLG-SC-LOC-026-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: Here is a bag for your shoes. Please tell us when you are ready.

DLG-SC-LOC-026-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-026-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 両方脱げました。袋へ入れて持ちます。戻る時も履く時間が必要なので、次の予定を少し後ろへずらしたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-026-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 脱靴収納を終え帰路着靴時間も考え次予定を後ろへ調整したいと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-026-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: I have taken both off. I will put them in the bag and carry it. I will need time to put them back on when returning, so I want to move the next plan a little later.
DLG-SC-LOC-026-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you have removed and packed your shoes, and want to move the next plan later to allow time to put them on again. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-026-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-026-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 出口で靴を履く椅子もご利用いただけます。
DLG-SC-LOC-026-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: You can also use the chair at the exit to put on your shoes.

DLG-SC-LOC-026-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-026-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 帰りの準備場所も分かりました。連れと次の予定を合わせたので、落ち着いて一緒に見学を始められます。
DLG-SC-LOC-026-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 帰路準備場所と同行者予定調整を確認し一緒に落ち着いて見学を始める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-026-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: I know where to get ready on the way back too. I have coordinated the next plan with my companion, so we can calmly begin the visit together.
DLG-SC-LOC-026-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm the place to prepare on the way back and coordination with your companion, then calmly begin the visit together. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-026-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-026-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: どうぞゆっくりご覧ください。それでは、ご見学をお楽しみください。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-026-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please take your time looking around. Enjoy your visit. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-026-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-026-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お写真の場所をお探しですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-026-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you looking for a place to take a photograph?

DLG-SC-LOC-026-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-026-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 家族五人で記念に撮りたいです。横一列だと道いっぱいになるので、通る方の邪魔にならない並び方を考えています。
DLG-SC-LOC-026-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 五人家族の横一列が道をふさぐため撮影位置を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-026-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: Our family of five wants a commemorative photo. A single row would fill the path, so we are considering an arrangement that does not inconvenience people passing.
DLG-SC-LOC-026-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask about the photo position because a row of five family members would block the path. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-026-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-026-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: こちらの脇で、二列になっていただけます。撮影する方は別にいらっしゃいますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-026-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: You can stand in two rows at this side. Is someone else taking the photograph?

DLG-SC-LOC-026-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-026-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 兄が撮ります。四人が写る時は二列にして、兄も入る写真は後で別に撮ることにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-026-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 兄が撮影し四人は二列で兄の写真は後で撮る計画を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-026-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: My older brother will take it. When four of us are in the photo, we will stand in two rows, and we will take another photo with my brother in it later.
DLG-SC-LOC-026-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that your brother will photograph four people in two rows and his photo will be taken later. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-026-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-026-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 今、こちらの場所をご利用いただけます。通行の流れをご覧になってからどうぞ。
DLG-SC-LOC-026-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: You can use this spot now. Please check the flow of people before starting.

DLG-SC-LOC-026-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-026-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 前を通る方がいなくなりました。二人ずつ並び、兄に一枚撮ってもらいます。全員の顔が入る距離でよさそうです。
DLG-SC-LOC-026-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 通行が途切れた時に二人ずつ並び一枚撮影を実行する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-026-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: There is nobody passing in front now. We will stand two in each row and have my brother take one photo. This distance seems to fit everyone's faces.
DLG-SC-LOC-026-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: When people stop passing, stand two in each row and take one photograph. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-026-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-026-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 撮れましたか。次の方もお待ちです。
DLG-SC-LOC-026-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: Have you taken it? The next people are waiting too.

DLG-SC-LOC-026-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-026-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 撮れました。ここを先に空けます。兄の写真は、別の空いている所で私が撮ると家族にも伝えました。
DLG-SC-LOC-026-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 一枚完了後待つ人へ場所を空け兄の撮影は別位置へ切り替える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-026-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes. We will clear this spot first. I also told my family I will photograph my brother at another unoccupied spot.
DLG-SC-LOC-026-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: After taking one photo, clear the spot for those waiting and move your brother's photo to another place. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-026-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-026-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 荷物も一緒にお持ちください。

DLG-SC-LOC-026-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-026-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 全員の鞄を持ちました。最初の一枚で家族の思い出を残せたので、ここで何度も撮り直さず見学へ戻ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-026-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 全員の荷物を回収し一枚の記念を残して見学へ戻ると話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-026-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: We have everyone's bags. The first photo captured a family memory, so we will return to looking around rather than retake it repeatedly here.
DLG-SC-LOC-026-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you have collected everyone's belongings and will return to the visit with one commemorative photo. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-026-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-026-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ご協力ありがとうございます。それでは、皆様でご参拝をお楽しみください。お気をつけて。
DLG-SC-LOC-026-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Thank you for your cooperation. Enjoy worshipping together. Take care.

DLG-SC-LOC-026-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-026-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 次のお部屋へ進みます。皆様そろっていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-026-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: We are moving to the next room. Is everyone here?

DLG-SC-LOC-026-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-026-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: すみません。私は今、化粧室へ行きたいです。黙って離れると人数が分からなくなるので、先にお伝えします。
DLG-SC-LOC-026-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 化粧室のため団体を離れる前に人数確認中のガイドへ申告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-026-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: Excuse me. I need to go to the restroom now. Leaving without saying anything would make the headcount unclear, so I am telling you first.
DLG-SC-LOC-026-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Before leaving the group for the restroom, tell the guide who is checking the headcount. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-026-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-026-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 承知しました。ここで案内を離れることになります。お連れの方はいらっしゃいますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-026-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: Understood. You will leave the guided tour here. Do you have a companion?

DLG-SC-LOC-026-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-026-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 妻と一緒です。妻は案内を最後まで聞きたいので、私だけ離れ、出口で会うことにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-026-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 妻は最後まで見学し本人だけ離れて出口合流と決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-026-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: I am with my wife. She wants to hear the guide to the end, so only I will leave, and we will meet at the exit.
DLG-SC-LOC-026-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Decide that your wife will visit to the end, while only you leave and meet her at the exit. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-026-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-026-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 化粧室への経路と、この案内が終わる出口を図でご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-026-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please check the route to the restroom and the exit where this tour finishes on the map.

DLG-SC-LOC-026-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-026-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 化粧室はこの方向、合流は出口の時計の前ですね。妻にも同じ場所を伝えました。
DLG-SC-LOC-026-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 図の化粧室方向と時計前合流場所を確認し妻へ共有する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-026-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: The restroom is this way, and we meet in front of the clock at the exit, right? I have told my wife the same place.
DLG-SC-LOC-026-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Check the restroom direction and meeting point by the clock on the map, and share them with your wife. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-026-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-026-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 途中のお部屋へ戻って団体を探すより、出口でお待ちいただくと分かりやすいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-026-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: It is clearer to wait at the exit rather than return to rooms along the route looking for the group.

DLG-SC-LOC-026-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-026-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 出口へ向かいます。妻を探しながら別の案内の列へ入る必要はないと分かりました。
DLG-SC-LOC-026-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 別団体を探さず案内出口へ進んで待つと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-026-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will head for the exit. I understand I do not need to join another guided line while looking for my wife.
DLG-SC-LOC-026-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will head for the tour's exit and wait instead of searching among other groups. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-026-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-026-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 見られなかった部分は、持ち帰りの案内でお確かめいただけます。
DLG-SC-LOC-026-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: You can check the parts you missed in the guide to take home.

DLG-SC-LOC-026-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-026-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 帰ってから案内を読みます。妻には最後まで見学を楽しんでもらい、私は用事を済ませて出口で待ちます。
DLG-SC-LOC-026-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 未見学部分は帰宅後資料で読み妻の見学継続を尊重すると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-026-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will read the guide after getting home. I will let my wife enjoy the visit to the end, while I take care of my need and wait at the exit.
DLG-SC-LOC-026-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will read about missed parts at home and respect your wife's continued visit. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-026-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-026-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ご連絡ありがとうございます。それでは、図の経路でお進みください。お気をつけて。
DLG-SC-LOC-026-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Thank you for letting us know. Please follow the route on the map. Take care.

DLG-SC-LOC-026-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-026-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お父様は、今日は少し休みたいとお話しされています。
DLG-SC-LOC-026-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Your father says he would like to rest a little today.

DLG-SC-LOC-026-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-026-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 家族の近況をたくさん話そうと思って来ました。父が今休みたいなら、今日は短い挨拶に変えたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-026-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 父の休息希望を受け準備した長い近況話を短い挨拶へ変える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-026-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: I came planning to tell him a lot of family news. If he wants to rest now, I would like to change to a brief greeting today.
DLG-SC-LOC-026-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Respond to your father's wish to rest by changing prepared lengthy family news to a brief greeting. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-026-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-026-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: そのご希望をお父様に伝えます。持って来られた物はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-026-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: I will tell your father that preference. Have you brought anything?

DLG-SC-LOC-026-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-026-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 家族の写真を何枚も用意しましたが、今日全部説明するより、短い手紙を一緒に置けたらと思います。
DLG-SC-LOC-026-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 多数写真を全説明するより短い手紙を置く提案をする。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-026-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: I prepared many family photographs, but rather than explain them all today, I was hoping to leave a short letter with him.
DLG-SC-LOC-026-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Suggest leaving a short letter rather than explaining many photographs in full. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-026-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-026-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: お父様は手紙を受け取りたいそうです。写真は後日、見たい時に持ってきてほしいとのことです。
DLG-SC-LOC-026-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: Your father says he would like to receive the letter. He asks you to bring the photographs another day when he wants to see them.

DLG-SC-LOC-026-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-026-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: では手紙だけにします。次に来る時、父がどの写真を見たいか聞いてから用意します。
DLG-SC-LOC-026-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 父の手紙希望を受け写真は本人希望を聞いて後日持参すると話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-026-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: Then I will give only the letter. For my next visit, I will ask which photos he wants to see before preparing them.
DLG-SC-LOC-026-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Accept your father's preference for the letter and say you will bring photos later after asking what he wants. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-026-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-026-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 今日の挨拶では、何を伝えたいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-026-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: What would you like to say in today's greeting?

DLG-SC-LOC-026-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-026-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 家族が気にかけていることと、返事は休んでからでよいことを伝えたいです。長い返事を今もらう必要はありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-026-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 家族の気持ちと返信は休息後でよいことを伝えたいと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-026-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: I want to say that the family cares about him and that he can reply after resting. I do not need a long reply now.
DLG-SC-LOC-026-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you want to convey the family's care and that a reply can wait until after rest. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-026-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-026-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: そのお言葉で、短くお話しできます。
DLG-SC-LOC-026-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: You can say that briefly in those words.

DLG-SC-LOC-026-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-026-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 手紙にも同じことを書きました。今日は短く挨拶して帰り、父が休む時間を残します。
DLG-SC-LOC-026-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 同内容を手紙へ書き短い面会後帰宅して父の休息時間を残す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-026-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: I wrote the same thing in the letter. I will give a short greeting and go home today, leaving my father time to rest.
DLG-SC-LOC-026-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Write the same message in the letter and go home after a brief visit to leave your father time to rest. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-026-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-026-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ご希望を合わせられましたね。それでは、お部屋へご案内します。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-026-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: You have coordinated your preferences. I will show you to his room. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-026-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-026-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 見学のご相談ですね。参加される方について伺えますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-026-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: You would like to discuss a visit, correct? Could you tell me about the participants?

DLG-SC-LOC-026-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-026-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 近所の子ども六人が警察の仕事に興味を持っています。大人の引率は今のところ私だけなので、その人数で相談してよいか知りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-026-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 六人の子どもに大人一人引率で警察仕事の見学相談を申し出る。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-026-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: Six neighborhood children are interested in police work. At present I am the only adult escort, so I want to know if I can consult you with those numbers.
DLG-SC-LOC-026-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask to discuss a visit about police work for six children escorted by one adult. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-026-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-026-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 希望の日程や年齢と一緒に、引率の状況を担当へお伝えします。
DLG-SC-LOC-026-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: I will tell the person in charge about the escort situation along with your preferred dates and the children's ages.

DLG-SC-LOC-026-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-026-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 年齢は七歳から九歳です。子どもたちは車の話を聞きたがっていますが、実際の車へ乗る約束はしていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-026-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 年齢七九歳と車の話題希望を示し乗車は約束していないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-026-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: They are seven to nine years old. The children want to hear about vehicles, but I have not promised they can ride in an actual vehicle.
DLG-SC-LOC-026-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Give ages seven to nine and the requested topic of vehicles, and say you have not promised rides. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-026-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-026-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 対応できる見学内容は担当が確認します。日程はもう決まっていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-026-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: The person in charge will check what the visit can include. Have the dates been decided yet?

DLG-SC-LOC-026-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-026-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 候補を二つ考えました。ほかの保護者へ連絡して、もう一人引率できる方がいるか確認してから人数をまとめます。
DLG-SC-LOC-026-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 候補日二つと追加引率保護者の確認後に参加人数をまとめると話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-026-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: I have thought of two possible dates. I will contact other parents to see whether another adult can escort them, then finalize the participant numbers.
DLG-SC-LOC-026-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you have two possible dates and will organize participant numbers after checking for another parent escort. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-026-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-026-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: まとまった内容をこちらへお知らせください。子どもたちには、確認が終わってから予定をお伝えください。
DLG-SC-LOC-026-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please let us know the organized details. Tell the children the plan after the checks are complete.

DLG-SC-LOC-026-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-026-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 先に募集の紙を配るより、内容と引率が決まってから案内します。年齢と希望の話題をメモにしました。
DLG-SC-LOC-026-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 内容引率確定後に募集を案内し年齢話題メモを用意する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-026-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: Rather than handing out a recruitment sheet first, I will give information once the activities and escorts are decided. I have noted the ages and topics they want to hear about.
DLG-SC-LOC-026-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Provide recruitment information after the activities and escorts are confirmed and prepare notes of ages and topics. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-026-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-026-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 保護者の連絡先は、代表の方から伺えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-026-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: We can ask the representative for the parents' contact details.

DLG-SC-LOC-026-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-026-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 私が代表の連絡先を伝えます。子ども全員の私的な情報を先に集めるのではなく、まず見学相談に必要なことを聞きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-026-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 代表連絡先を示し全員の個人情報より見学相談の必要項目を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-026-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will provide my contact as the representative. Rather than collecting every child's private information in advance, I will first ask what is needed to discuss the visit.
DLG-SC-LOC-026-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Give the representative's contact and ask what the visit consultation requires rather than collecting everyone's personal information. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-026-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-026-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、担当の問い合わせ方法をご案内します。それでは、ご準備の後にご連絡ください。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-026-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: I will explain how to contact the person in charge. Please contact us after your preparations. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-026-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-026-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お二人で、おそろいの服をお探しですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-026-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are the two of you looking for matching clothes?

DLG-SC-LOC-026-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-026-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 妹と旅行の記念に買おうとしています。妹は明るい色が好きですが、私は落ち着いた色を着たいので、同じ服にするか迷っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-026-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 姉妹の色の好みが異なり同じ記念服を選び難いと相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-026-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: We are thinking of buying them as a souvenir of a trip with my younger sister. She likes bright colors, but I want to wear subdued colors, so I am unsure about getting the same clothes.
DLG-SC-LOC-026-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Discuss difficulty choosing matching souvenir clothes because the sisters have different color preferences. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-026-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-026-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 服はそれぞれの色を選び、同じ小物を合わせる方法もあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-026-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: You can each choose your own color of clothing and match the same accessory.

DLG-SC-LOC-026-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-026-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: それなら二人とも楽しめそうです。服は別の色にして、共通の飾りを見せていただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-026-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 別色服と共通小物という代案を選び飾りを見せてほしいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-026-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: Then we could both enjoy it. Could we have different colors of clothes and see a matching ornament?
DLG-SC-LOC-026-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Choose the alternative of different clothing colors and a matching accessory, and ask to see ornaments. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-026-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-026-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: この小さいブローチなら、違う色の服にも合わせられます。
DLG-SC-LOC-026-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: This small brooch can go with different colors of clothes.

DLG-SC-LOC-026-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-026-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 私は紺の服へ合わせたいです。妹は白にするそうなので、二つの服の前でブローチを置いて見比べたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-026-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 本人紺と妹白の服で同形ブローチを見比べる提案をする。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-026-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: I want to match it with navy clothing. My sister says she will choose white, so I would like to place the brooch in front of both outfits and compare.
DLG-SC-LOC-026-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Suggest comparing the same brooch shape on your navy clothes and your sister's white clothes. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-026-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-026-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: こちらへ二色の見本を並べます。鏡でもお確かめください。
DLG-SC-LOC-026-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: I will put the two color samples side by side here. Please check in the mirror too.

DLG-SC-LOC-026-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-026-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: どちらにも同じ形が見えますね。妹にも聞いたら、この小さい形がよいと言っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-026-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 二色に合う同形を確認し妹も小型を希望したと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-026-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: The same shape is visible on both, right? I also asked my sister, and she says she likes this small shape.
DLG-SC-LOC-026-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Confirm the same shape suits both colors and say your sister also wants the small design. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-026-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-026-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: ブローチ二つのお会計でよろしいですか。服は今日はお求めになりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-026-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: Shall I charge for two brooches? Will you buy the clothes today?

DLG-SC-LOC-026-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-026-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 今日はブローチだけにします。服を無理にそろえなくても、二人の記念を持てると分かりました。
DLG-SC-LOC-026-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 服は購入せず同形ブローチ二つだけで姉妹の記念にすると決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-026-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: Today we will get only the brooches. I have realized we can have a memento together without forcing ourselves to match our clothes.
DLG-SC-LOC-026-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Decide not to buy clothes but to make two matching brooches the sisters' mementos. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-026-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-026-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 同じ形を二つご用意します。それでは、姉妹で旅の思い出をお楽しみください。ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-026-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: I will prepare two of the same shape. Enjoy the memories of your trip as sisters. Thank you.
